    woman_idx = woman_centers.index(closest_woman)
    scarf_idx = scarf_centers.index(closest_scarf)
    
    if abs(woman_idx - scarf_idx) <= 1:
        return woman_patches[woman_idx]
    
    return image_patch

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    people_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    if not people_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Sort people by their horizontal center
    people_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Find the person closest to the center of the image
    central_person = people_patches[len(people_patches) // 2]
    
    # Find all items in the image
    items_patches = image_patch.find("item")
    
    # Filter out items that are not close to the central person
    items_near_person = [item for item in items_patches if abs(item.horizontal_center - central_person.horizontal_center) < 50]
    
    # Sort items near the person by their vertical center
    items_near_person.sort(key=lambda p: p.vertical_center)
    
    # Find the item closest to the person vertically
    top_item_near_person = items_near_person[0]
    
    # Find all items that are below the top item near the person
    bottom_items = [item for item in items_patches if item.vertical_center > top_item_near_person.vertical_center]
    
    # Sort bottom items by their horizontal center
    bottom_items.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Find the item closest to the person horizontally among the bottom items
    closest_bottom_item = bottom_items[0]
    
    return closest_bottom_item

    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    if not man_patches: return image_patch
    
    # Filter for bald men
    bald_men = [man for man in man_patches if man.verify_property("hair", "bald")]
    if not bald_men: return image_patch
    
    # Find the man in the middle
    middle_index = len(bald_men) // 2
    return bald_men[middle_index]
